_source: product/v0-spec/09-VERIFICATION.md §2/§3/§4 + CANONICAL-DECISIONS.md (enumerated by the Phase-1 Doc-09 reader)
_note: The journey-closure oracle for check_completeness.py A3. Every node's journeys_now_live and every scenario's journey_id must be one of these ids. Hidden/derived candidate journeys are in decisions.md for HALT-1 review (Tier B + human decide which become journeys vs node-level obligations).

_descriptions.J-09-registry-closed: §2 assert_registry_closed(): MessageType set == CHANNEL_REGISTRY; produced-but-unconsumed fails build; runs CI + boot (excludes signal-surface types per CANONICAL §11.8)
_descriptions.J-09-contracts-resolve: §2 every doc's wire shape imports the literal type from libs/contracts; no doc re-declares a shared type; incl. field-level produce/consume diff
_descriptions.J-09-one-operation-runs: §2 exactly one operation_runs table def; reconcile sweep reaps duplicates
_descriptions.J-09-agentchunk-stream-deltas: §2 AgentChunk consumers use stream_deltas; no raw TEXT chunk read; .type/.metadata access
_descriptions.J-09-cost-drafts-persist: §2 meeting_cost + staged_drafts rows exist AND survive a simulated process kill
_descriptions.J-09-S1-happy-arc: §3 connect repo → invite → grounded spoken+chat answer → meeting ends → notes file posted (01·02·03·04·05·08, latency SLO per CANONICAL §12.8)
_descriptions.J-09-S2-dep-graph-blast-radius: §3 'what breaks if we change this table?' from dep graph in ~1 tool call, grounded, honest about coverage (01·04·02)
_descriptions.J-09-S3-staged-draft-accept: §3 real work → staged draft persists → 'verified' past critic+evidence gate → human accept AFTER teardown applies it (05·04·08)
_descriptions.J-09-S4-barge-in-human-control: §3 interrupt mid-sentence / 'quiet' / 'stop' → speech stops <200ms; in-flight build aborts (abort-is-final); human ask preempts (02·04)
_descriptions.J-09-S5-recycle-survives: §3 kill orchestrator mid-meeting → replacement re-claims → replays transcript → continues; meeting_cost reloads (04·03·00)
_descriptions.J-09-S6-concurrency: §3 several meetings on one host → no cross-meeting starvation; tenant isolation holds; sandboxes independent (04·05)
_descriptions.J-09-S7-cost-circuit-breaker: §3 cross $1/hr → soft cap degrades (Haiku, widen Scribe) with spoken disclosure; hard cap → notes-only; never silent cliff (03·04·05)
_descriptions.J-09-S8-honest-failure: §3 index not-ready / tool error / STT gap → says what it can't see, never confident-wrong (Law 1); failed build → needs_review/failed (01·05·02)
_descriptions.J-09-S9-tenant-isolation: §3 guest/crafted message without valid owned meeting_id rejected; no cross-tenant code read (08 dispatch funnel)
_descriptions.J-09-demo-arc: §4 ONE continuous run spanning ALL docs: connect → ready+coverage → 2 grounded answers → Workroom draft (verified, needs_review) → orchestrator recycles once & continues → cost in-envelope → notes+draft persist → human accepts post-call
